name: Deck Maker
tagline: Builds a polished, fully editable PowerPoint from your numbers and your decision.
delivers: A native .pptx: every title, shape, chart and table stays editable
Speaker notes with context and sources

brief.label: Who is it for, and what should they decide?
brief.example: Investment committee deciding whether to fund a feasibility study

brief.label: The facts and numbers to use
brief.example: SGD 1.8M capex, 1.25 GWh/yr, SGD 310k/yr savings, 14 months

brief.label: Length and look
brief.example: Six slides, restrained, dark olive and cream

limits: Uses only the facts you supply. Anything missing is marked TBD; nothing is researched or invented.
